description: FIND-D (completion poll) is NOT genuinely CLOSED for production. pollCompletions() exists as a pure, dependency-injected function and is unit-tested, but it is NEVER wired into any live path: pass() (the daemon entrypoint, bank-payout-watcher.mjs:132-144) calls only bankWatcherPass and never pollCompletions; the CLI block (bank-payout-watcher.mjs:146-148) only calls pass(); and a repo-wide search found zero cron/daemon/live invocation of pollCompletions or of any readSubmitted/queryStatus/requeue implementation. Consequently every recipient that bankWatcherPass marks 'submitted' (the success path) is left permanently 'submitted' in production — never promoted to 'paid', never requeued on GMO failure. The state machine claimed by FIND-D is dead in production.

evidence.snippet: export async function pollCompletions({ readSubmitted, queryStatus, markPaid, requeue }) { ... }  // exported + tested, but pass() never calls it and no live readSubmitted/queryStatus/requeue exists anywhere
